title: Generic GLB/GLTF carriers were classified as Godot presentation kind
surface: Creative Library carrier dispatch and medium filters
symptom: A Blender-authored GLB appeared as kind=godot and caused the work modality list to include godot even though the work has no Godot source or runtime dependency.
fix: Use generic presentation hint model for .glb/.gltf while retaining godot for .godot/.tscn/.gd. This remains a UI dispatch hint, not preservation format authority.
verification: Rebuilt the live PostgreSQL-backed Creative Library and required media:convergence-object-001 to expose model, not godot, while preserving its PNG hero/launch carrier.
truthBoundary: This corrects navigation semantics only. PRONOM/Siegfried or another preservation identifier remains format identity authority.
